author: bitwisecook
body:
Partial fix published; keeping this open for Jim.

The C Tcl 8.4–9.1 path is fixed by [02a9c35c6](https://github.com/bitwisecook/tcl-lsp/commit/02a9c35c696354020b233385749ded603f2858b7). Argument-evaluation and proved-name bookkeeping stages no longer enter the opaque-callee name inventory; their word/SSA effects remain executable. On the exact reported source, W210 now appears at both later reads: `$x` bytes 79–81 and `$y` bytes 105–107.

Fresh verification used `ad4d43160916c343e8376763cfbefba9fc184ad5` plus that same stage patch, with compiler rlib SHA-256 `d4012741853e0713f64960e6b46711abf7668a50abe74092235b4bb51251de66`:

- `cargo clippy -p tcl-compiler --lib --locked -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo test -p tcl-compiler --test w210_empty_loop_source --test w210_short_circuit --no-run --locked`, then the emitted binaries directly: 3/3 and 2/2 tests passed, covering 100 C-profile verdicts, the distinct opaque-call sentinel/CFG control, and 185 existing guard/admission rows. Sources, binaries and all 145 dependencies were unchanged through the runs.
- [Exact sources, actual/expected spans, commands, logs and custody records](https://github.com/bitwisecook/tcl-lsp/tree/02a9c35c696354020b233385749ded603f2858b7/rust/tcl-compiler/tests/data/w210-empty-loop-exact-source/reviewed-stage-snapshot/current-ad4).

Jim is still incomplete. The combined program loses the procedure loop's selected target, while standalone controls warn. The audit distinguishes top-level empty-loop source-world loss from a separate conditional Jim body-shape gap. Native runs confirm that empty loops skip stores/body evaluation while argument substitutions and available observers retain their effects; Jim's malformed-list behaviour and unavailable variable-trace interface are recorded explicitly ([native controls](https://github.com/bitwisecook/tcl-lsp/blob/68df69c92cd2a9116c866b1fce14e592bd476d73/evidence/tcl/w210-empty-foreach-source-phase-controls-2026-11-04.md), [observer controls](https://github.com/bitwisecook/tcl-lsp/blob/68df69c92cd2a9116c866b1fce14e592bd476d73/evidence/tcl/w210-empty-foreach-observer-boundaries-2026-11-04.md)).

At the user's stop/push request, [cf77ac5566](https://github.com/bitwisecook/tcl-lsp/commit/cf77ac5566) preserves the current isolated Jim draft as an **UNBUILT development checkpoint**. No compiler, lint or regression result is claimed for it. It needs review and focused tests before either Jim gap can be called fixed. No broader Native/physical-frame authority or full workspace gate success is claimed.
